values.meaning: bonus true damage on Q burst per Stardust stack, as % of target's max health
values.quote: Bursts deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
values.binNote: Wiki calls this bonus damage 'magic damage' in the description, but the bin data value name and calculation (QMaxHealthTrueDamagePerStack) indicate it is true damage; also seen as AurelionSolQ#BurstBonusTrueDamageToChamps.

values.meaning: Astral Flight range increase per Stardust stack
values.quote: Range is increased by {{as|{{fd|7.5}} units per Stardust}}.

values.meaning: increase to Singularity's base execution threshold per Stardust stack
values.binNote: BaseExecutionThreshold (5) is the flat base threshold before Stardust scaling; only the per-stack growth term (ExecutionGrowthPerBreakpoint) is the passive's contribution stated here.

mechanics.claim: Stardust stacks are gained permanently from damaging abilities landing on enemies.
mechanics.quote: Aurelion Sol's damaging abilities against enemies generate him permanent stacks of Stardust, which gradually augments his abilities.

mechanics.claim: Singularity's execution threshold is increased by Stardust in addition to its radius.
mechanics.quote: Outer and inner radius increased equal to 15% Stardust, and the execution threshold is increased.

mechanics.claim: Falling Star/The Skies Descend impact radius scales with Stardust but this does not change damage per instance.
mechanics.quote: Impact radius increased equal to 15% Stardust.

mechanics.claim: Singularity's relative inner/outer radius ratio is preserved when scaled by Stardust.
mechanics.quote: relative size and ratio stays the same when affected by ''Cosmic Creator's'' size modifier.
